text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d s-y-n-t-h-e-t-i-c g-p-s c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e s-e-t s, l-e-f-t f-a-l-s-e p-l-o-t m-a-p-s i-n t-h-e p-r-o-j-e-c-t f-o-l-d-e-r, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d t-h-e g-e-o-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d s-a-t-e-l-l-i-t-e i-m-a-g-e r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e s, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-e-d c-o-m-p-o-s-i-t-e d-a-t-a e-x-t-r-a-c-t s a-s e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e, a-n-d o-m-i-t-t-e-d t-h-e r-a-w i-m-a-g-e-y a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d i-n-v-e-n-t-e-d v-e-r-i-f-i-e-r r-e-p-o-r-t s, s-t-o-r-e-d c-o-u-n-t-e-r-f-e-i-t i-s-s-u-a-n-c e r-e-c-o-r-d s i-n t-h-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-r-c-h-i-v-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-s-s-e-m-b-l-e-d a c-o-m-m-e-r-c-i-a l s-a-l-e s n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e, f-i-l-e-d t-h-e p-r-o-m-o-t-i-o-n a-l-g-o-r-i-t-h-m w-i-t-h i-n-v-e-n-t-e-d m-e-t-r-i-c s, a-n-d n-e-g-l-e-c-t-e-d t-h-e f-a-c-t c-h-e-c-k p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-l-a-y-e-d t-h-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t s e-t t-o i-m-i-t-a-t-e b-u-y-e-r d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e s, a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d t-h-e a-n-s-w-e-r t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e s a-s p-r-a-c-t-i-c-e m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l, a-n-d l-e-f-t o-u-t t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n l-o-o-p.
